<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" ana="corpusmd:whole_text" status="reviewed"> 
         <ab xml:space="preserve" type="incipit"> 
         <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1012023-01-2014-17-31" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="Cover page (1a)"/>
         <pb n="1a"/><lb n="1a1"/>        
          || <rs type="work" ref="db:4422" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lU i pa'i bstod pa yid bzhin nor bu</rs> <abbr>bzhugs s+ho</abbr> ||</seg>
         </ab>

         <ab xml:space="preserve">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Body of the text (1b1–2a5)"/>
         <milestone unit="section" n="1"/>
         <pb n="1b"/><lb n="1b1"/> <lg><l>gang gis 'khor ba'i nyaMs thag ni ||</l> <l>dran pa bal gyis 'joMs mdzad cing ||</l> <l>bla med <abbr>byang chub</abbr> thob mdzad pa ||</l> <l>bla ma'i zhabs la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="2"/>
         <lg><l>skye med ngang mas thugs rje <abbr>chen po</abbr> yis ||</l> <l>keng rus<anchor xml:id="a1"/> <lb n="1b2"/> <abbr>'jigs</abbr> su rung pa'i gdan stengs su<anchor xml:id="a2"/> ||</l> <l>bdud 'dul hUM las <abbr>khro bo</abbr>'i sku sprul ba ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog</rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="3"/>
        <lg> <l>chos dbyings rnaM dag 'gyur med <abbr>nam mkha'</abbr> la ||</l> 
         <l>mtshon pa'i skur bstan dpa' bo'i rgyan gyis spras ||</l> 
         <l><lb n="1b3"/> thabs dang <abbr>shes rab</abbr> <abbr>gnyis</abbr> med rol ba mdzad ||</l> 
         <l><rs type="deity">bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog</rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="4"/>
         <lg><l>dpa' bo'i stang<anchor xml:id="a3"/> stabs khro bo 'jigs su rung ||</l> <l>sgeg pa'i nyaMs can <abbr>snogs</abbr> rgyan gyis spras ||</l> <l><abbr>rgod dang</abbr> mi sdug snying rjes zhi ba mdzad ||</l> <l><lb n="1b4"/> 'gal ba'i chos 'chang <rs type="deity">bde mchog</rs> <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="5"/>
        <lg> <l>gang la <abbr>chags</abbr> dang sdang ba mi mnga' yang ||</l> <l>gang gis 'dul ba <choice><reg>de dang</reg><orig>‹de dang›</orig></choice> de'i sras ||</l> <l><abbr>chags</abbr> sogs <abbr>nyon mongs</abbr> kun tu zhi mdzad pa'i ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog</rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="6"/>
        <lg><l>sgrib <abbr>gnyis</abbr> <lb n="1b5"/> nyes pa'i rgyu <abbr>tshogs</abbr> <abbr>rnaM par</abbr> spang‹s›<anchor xml:id="a4"/> ||</l> <l><abbr>sdug bsngal</abbr> <abbr>'bras bu'i<anchor xml:id="a5"/></abbr> <abbr>tshogs</abbr> dang bral ba nyid ||</l> <l>'khor dang <abbr>mya ngan</abbr> 'da'<anchor xml:id="a6"/> la mi gnas pa'i ||</l> <l><abbr>gnyis</abbr> med <abbr>ye shes</abbr> <rs type="deity">bde mchog</rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal</abbr> ||</l></lg> 

        <milestone unit="section" n="7"/>
   <lg>     <l>dag pa chos sku'i sprul pa ni ||</l> <l><abbr>dmigs</abbr> pa med pa'i <lb n="1b6"/> <abbr>thugs rje</abbr> yis ||</l> <l><abbr>gzugs</abbr> sku sgyu ma ltar ston pa ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">rdo rje phag mo <!--=Vajravārāhī--></rs> <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="8"/>
       <lg> <l><abbr>ye shes</abbr> <abbr>bzhi</abbr>'i ngo bo yi ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">mkha' 'gro <!--=Ḍākinī--> la ma <!--=Lāmā--> dum skyes ma <!--=Khaṇḍarohā--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">gzugs can ma <!--="=Rūpiṇī--></rs> dang thod pa <abbr>bzhi</abbr> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">bde chen 'khor lo</rs> phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg>
        <note type="gloss">'khor lo gsum gyi *** rnaMs la bstod pa ni ||</note>

         <milestone unit="section" n="9"/>
       <lg> <l> <rs type="deity">rab tu gtum<anchor xml:id="a7"/> mo <!--=Pracaṇḍā--></rs> <rs type="deity">gtuM mig <lb n="1b7"/> ma <!--=Caṇḍākṣī--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">'od ldan sna tshogs<anchor xml:id="a8"/> <!--=Mahānāsā--></rs> <rs type="deity">brtan pa'i blo <!--=Vīramatī--></rs> ||</l> 
         <l><rs type="deity">mi thung <!--="Kharvarī--></rs> <rs type="deity">lang ka'i dbang phyug ma <!--="Laṅkeśvarī--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">shing grib ma <!--=Drumacchāyā--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="10"/>
  <lg>      <l><rs type="deity">sa bsrungs ma <!--=Airāvatī--></rs> dang <rs type="deity">'jigs byed che <!--=Mahābhairavī--></rs> ||</l> 
   <l><rs type="deity">rlung shugs <!--=Vāyuvegā--></rs> <rs type="deity">chang 'thung <!--=Surābhakṣī--></rs> <rs type="deity">ljang lha mo <!--=Śyāmadevī--></rs> ||</l> 
   <l><pb n="2a"/><lb n="2a1"/> <rs type="deity">shin tu bzang mo <!--=Subhadrā--></rs> <rs type="deity">rta sna mo <!--=Hayakarṇā--></rs> ||</l> 
   <l><rs type="deity">bya gdong ma <!--=Khagānanā--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal</abbr> lo ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="11"/>
     <lg>    <l><rs type="deity">'khor shug<anchor xml:id="a9"/> <!--=Cakravegā--></rs> <rs type="deity">kha NDa ro ha <!--=Khaṇḍarohā--></rs> dang ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">chang 'thung <!--=Śauṇḍinī--></rs> <rs type="deity">go cha <!--=Cakravarmiṇī--> rab dpa' mo <!--=Suvīrā--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">stobs chen <!--=Mahābalā--> 'khor lo bsgyur ma <!--=Cakravartinī--></rs> dang ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">brtson chen ma <!--=Mahāvīryā--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal</abbr> lo ||</l></lg>
         <note type="gloss">dpa' ba rnaMs la bstod pa ni ||</note>

         <milestone unit="section" n="12"/>
<lg>       <l><rs type="deity">thod pa'i <lb n="2a2"/> dum bu <!--=Khaṇḍakapālina--></rs> <rs type="deity">keng rus<anchor xml:id="a10"/> che <!--=Mahākaṅkāla--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">keng rus<anchor xml:id="a11"/> <!--=Kaṅkāla--></rs> <rs type="deity">mche rtsigs <!--=Vikaṭadaṃṣṭriṇa--> lha'i sgra <!--=Surāvairiṇa--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">'od dpag med <!--=Amitābha--> dang</rs> <rs type="deity">rdo rje'i 'od <!--=Vajraprabha--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">rdo rje sku <!--=Vajradeha--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal</abbr> bstod ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="13"/>
        <lg> <l><rs type="deity">myu gu can <!--=Aṅkurika--></rs> dang <rs type="deity">ral pa can <!--=Jaṭila--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">dpa' chen <!--=Mahāvīra--></rs> <rs type="deity">hUM mdzad <!--=Hūṃkāra--></rs> <rs type="deity">rab tu bzang<anchor xml:id="a12"/> <!--=Subhadra--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">rdo rje bzang <!--=Vajrabhadra--></rs> dang <lb n="2a3"/> <rs type="deity">'jigs byed che <!--=Mahābhairava--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">mig mi bzang <!--=Virūpākṣa--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="14"/>
       <lg><l><rs type="deity">stobs chen <!--=Mahābala--> rin chen rdo rje <!--=Ratnavajra--></rs> dang ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">rta mgrin <!--=Hayagrīva--> mkha' snying <!--=Ākāśagarbha--> he ru ka <!--=Heruka--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">padma gar dbang <!--=Padmanarteśvara--> rnaM snang <!--=Vairocana--></rs> dang ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">rdo rje seMs <!--=Vajrasattva--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>
       <note type="gloss">sgo 'tshams ma brgyad la bstod pa ni ||</note>

         <milestone unit="section" n="15"/>
       <lg> <l>phyogs <abbr>bzhi</abbr>'i sgo rnaMs skyong mdzad <lb n="2a4"/> pa ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">khwa gdong ma <!--=Kākāsyā--></rs> dang <rs type="deity">'ug gdong ma <!--=Ulūkāsyā--></rs> ||</l> <l>de <abbr>bzhin</abbr> <rs type="deity">khyi'i gdong ma <!--=Śvānāsyā--></rs> dang ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">phag gdong<anchor xml:id="a13"/> ma <!--=Śūkarāsyā--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>

         <milestone unit="section" n="16"/>
        <lg><l><abbr>gzugs</abbr> <abbr>gnyis</abbr> kyis ni yid 'phrog ma ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">brtan pa mo <!--=Ḍāḍhī--></rs> dang <rs type="deity">pho nya mo <!--=Dūtī--></rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">mche brtsigs ma <!--=Daṃṣṭriṇī--></rs> dang <rs type="deity">'joMs ma <!--=Mathanī--></rs> dang ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">gshin rje <lb n="2a5"/> bzhi <!--=Yama--></rs> la <abbr>phyag 'tshal lo</abbr> ||</l></lg>
         </ab>

            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3784">lots+tsha ba <abbr>rin chen</abbr> bzang po</rs>s <rs type="work" ref="db:4422" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">bstod pa</rs> <abbr>rdzogs</abbr> s+ho ||</seg>
            || dge'o ||</ab>
